mapper.select: SELECT dept_name FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId}

SELECT * FROM -- 成果转化 ( SELECT cgzh.cgzhdeptId, CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount < 2 THEN cgzh.cgzhAmount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS '成果转化2以下信息', CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 2 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 2 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 5 THEN cgzh.cgzhAmount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS '成果转化2-5信息', CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 5 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 5 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 10 THEN cgzh.cgzhAmount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS '成果转化5-10信息', CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 10 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 10 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 20 THEN cgzh.cgzhAmount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS '成果转化10-20信息', CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 20 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 20 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 35 THEN cgzh.cgzhAmount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS '成果转化20-35信息', CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 35 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN cgzh.cgzhAmount >= 35 AND cgzh.cgzhAmount < 50 THEN cgzh.cgzhAmount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS '成果转化35-50信息' FROM ( SELECT cgzh.parten, cgzh.deptId AS cgzhdeptId, cgzh.dept_name, cgzh.userId, cgzh.CGZHamount AS cgzhAmount FROM ( SELECT p.dept_id parten, s.dept_id deptId, p.dept_name dept_name, s.user_id userId, a.amount CGZHamount FROM sys_user s JOIN sci_IntraSchPro_apply a ON s.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id WHERE a.state = 6 ) cgzh LEFT JOIN sys_dept de ON de.dept_id = cgzh.deptId UNION SELECT cgzh.parten, de.dept_id AS deptId, de.dept_name, cgzh.userId, cgzh.CGZHamount AS cgzhAmount -- 这里也添加别名
FROM sys_dept de LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.dept_id parten, s.dept_id deptId, p.dept_name dept_name, s.user_id userId, a.amount CGZHamount FROM sys_user s JOIN sci_IntraSchPro_apply a ON s.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id WHERE a.state = 6 ) cgzh ON de.dept_id = cgzh.deptId WHERE cgzh.deptId IS NULL ) cgzh GROUP BY cgzh.cgzhdeptId ) cgzh

WHEN subquery.hxktamount > 0 AND subquery.hxktamount < 2 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "2万元以下", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 2 AND subquery.hxktamount < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 2 AND subquery.hxktamount < 5 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "2-5万元（含2）", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 5 AND subquery.hxktamount < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 5 AND subquery.hxktamount < 10 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "5-10万元（含5）", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 10 AND subquery.hxktamount < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 10 AND subquery.hxktamount < 20 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "10-20万元（含10）", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 20 AND subquery.hxktamount < 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 20 AND subquery.hxktamount < 35 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "20-35万元（含20）", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 35 AND subquery.hxktamount < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 35 AND subquery.hxktamount < 50 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "35-50万元（含35）", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 50 AND subquery.hxktamount < 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 50 AND subquery.hxktamount < 75 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "50-75万元（含50）", CONCAT( SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 75 AND subquery.hxktamount < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), ' 个 ( ', SUM( CASE WHEN subquery.hxktamount >= 75 AND subquery.hxktamount < 100 THEN subquery.hxktamount ELSE 0 END ), ' 万 )' ) AS "75-100万元（含75）" FROM ( SELECT p.dept_id parten, s.dept_id deptId, s.user_id userId, a.amount hxktamount FROM sys_user s JOIN sci_horizontal_apply a ON s.user_id = a.user_id JOIN sys_dept d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id WHERE a.state = 6 ) subquery GROUP BY hxktdeptId ) hxkt ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = hxkt.hxktdeptId
LEFT JOIN -- 纵向课题 ( SELECT deptId as zxktdeptId, CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持国家基金科研项目", CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持省部级基金科研项目", CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 3 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持省部级教改项目", CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 4 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持省部级纵向科研项目", CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 5 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持厅局级、学会级科研项目", CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 6 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持校级教学管理项目（1万元以上）", CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个 (', SUM(CASE WHEN Type = 7 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), '万)' ) AS "主持校级教学管理项目（1 万元以下）" FROM ( SELECT p.dept_id as parten, s.dept_id deptId, s.user_id userId, a.amount amount, a.top_type Type FROM sys_user s JOIN sci_horizontal_apply_vertical a ON s.user_id = a.user_id JOIN sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN sys_dept p on d.parent_id = p.dept_id WHERE a.state = 66 ) subquery GROUP BY deptId )zxkt ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = zxkt.zxktdeptId
LEFT JOIN -- 奖励 ( SELECT p.dept_id AS jlparent, d.dept_id AS jldeptId, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 1 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 省级教学成果奖数量, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 2 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 省级科学技术奖数量, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 3 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 省级一流精品课评比, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 4 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 市、厅局级自然科学类评奖, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 5 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 市、厅局级社科类评奖, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 6 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 校级教学成果奖, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 7 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 应用型科研校级成果奖, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 8 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 校级精品课评比, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.reward_fenlei = 9 AND s.reward_dengji IN (1, 2, 3) THEN s.reward_dengji ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 教师参加省级大赛获奖 FROM sys_reward s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id WHERE s.state = 6 GROUP BY p.dept_id, d.dept_id ) jl ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = jl.jldeptId
LEFT JOIN -- 专利 ( SELECT dept_id zldeptId, SUM(CASE WHEN l = 1 THEN count_per_group ELSE 0 END) AS "授权发明专利", SUM(CASE WHEN l = 2 THEN count_per_group ELSE 0 END) AS "实用新型专利", SUM(CASE WHEN l = 3 THEN count_per_group ELSE 0 END) AS "外型设计专利", SUM(CASE WHEN l = 4 THEN count_per_group ELSE 0 END) AS "计算机软件著作权" FROM ( -- 子查询：按 mingcheng 取最小 paiming 的记录 SELECT s.dept_id, a.fenlei AS l, COUNT(DISTINCT a.mingcheng) AS count_per_group FROM ( -- 步骤1：筛选每个 mingcheng 的最小 paiming 记录 SELECT a1.* FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT mingcheng, MIN(paiming) AS min_paiming -- 取优先级最高的 paiming（1→2→3→4） FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu where state = 6 GROUP BY mingcheng ) a2 ON a1.mingcheng = a2.mingcheng AND a1.paiming = a2.min_paiming ) a JOIN sys_user s ON s.user_id = a.user_id GROUP BY s.dept_id, a.fenlei ) AS subquery GROUP BY dept_id ) zl ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = zl.zldeptId
LEFT JOIN -- 论文 ( SELECT d.dept_id AS lwdeptId, -- d.dept_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SCI, SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EI, SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 核心, SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 三网, SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 普通, SUM(CASE WHEN p.paper_category = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 校办 FROM ( SELECT p1.paper_title, p1.paper_category, u.dept_id, p1.paper_ranking, p1.state, title_counts.title_count FROM sci_paper_a p1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p1.user_id = u.user_id JOIN ( SELECT paper_title, COUNT(*) as title_count FROM sci_paper_a GROUP BY paper_title ) title_counts ON p1.paper_title = title_counts.paper_title WHERE p1.state = 8 ) p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept pt ON d.parent_id = pt.dept_id WHERE (p.title_count = 1) OR (p.title_count > 1 AND p.paper_ranking = 1) GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name ) lw ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = lw.lwdeptId
LEFT JOIN -- 讲座报告 ( SELECT p.dept_id jzdeptId, -- p.dept_name as 学院, -- d.dept_name AS 专业, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.report_classify = 5 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS 举办国际, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.report_classify = 6 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS 举办国内, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.report_classify = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS 参加国际, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.report_classify = 7 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS 参加国内, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.report_classify = 4 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS 校级学术 FROM sci_lecture_report s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id GROUP BY p.dept_id
) jz ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = jz.jzdeptId
LEFT JOIN -- 教材 ( SELECT -- p.dept_id AS 学院, d.dept_id AS jzdeptId, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN j.fenlei IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 专著数量, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN j.fenlei IN (5, 6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS 教材数量 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT mingcheng, user_id, fenlei FROM sci_jiaocairuanzhu ) j LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON j.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id ) jc ON cgzh.cgzhdeptId = jc.jzdeptId
WHERE cgzhdeptId IN ( SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} OR find_in_set( #{deptId}, ancestors ) ) order by cgzhdeptId
